description: Replace the current topology with one read from a file written by save_topology (a bare get_topology JSON object is accepted too). Use an absolute path: relative paths resolve against $MCP_TRACER_DIR if set, else the server's working directory (now /tmp/churn-4bp5gvaz), which MCP clients often set arbitrarily. "~" is the user's home directory. Atomic: the file is fully parsed and validated (models, ports, links, IOS and host IP rules) before anything changes; on any error the current topology is kept. Max 5 MB.

path.description: File to read. Only .json file names are accepted; .json is added when the file name has no extension. Absolute path recommended.

name: load_topology
title: Load topology
